title: Design system
subtitle: Tokens and components of the new HappyClaw frontend

color.surfaceDescription: Canvas for the page, surface for cards, sunken for wells.
color.textDescription: Four levels: default, muted, subtle, disabled.
color.accentDescription: HappyClaw coral. Primary action, selection, focus.
color.statusDescription: Success, warning, danger and info, each with a soft fill.

type.sansDescription: Inter with CJK fallbacks. Body sits at 14px for dense product UI.
type.monoDescription: Model names, ids, token counts, code.

spacingDescription: 4px base scale. Gaps inside a component use 2–3, between blocks 4–6, between sections 8–12.
radiusDescription: 6px controls, 10px inputs, 14px cards, 18px panels, full for pills and avatars.
shadowDescription: Elevation is earned: xs on static cards, sm on hover and inputs, md on popovers, overlay on dialogs.
motionDescription: 120ms for hover, 180ms for enter and layout, 280ms for panels. Motion collapses to zero under prefers-reduced-motion.
layoutDescription: 244px expanded sidebar, 60px collapsed, 56px top bar, 760px reading column.
